description: This course provides a continuation of work done in PC2288/R and the project should be of two semesters' duration. It is enhanced with the Research Experience Programme, where students attend seminars and workshops, access writing consultations, receive a grant to do independent research, and present their findings at a conference. Please note that only 4 Units can be accredited towards major requirements in the case a student undertakes 8 Units for both PC2288/R and PC2289/R.
